# fea-structural-help — Copilot instructions

Follow `AGENTS.md` at the repository root. It routes each MSC Apex or MSC
Nastran question to one of the five skills in `skills/<name>/SKILL.md`. Read
the chosen skill's `SKILL.md` in full and follow its required workflow before
answering.

Always cite the documentation. Label anything beyond it as
**Not found in the documentation — general engineering knowledge:**.
